## About
SoCal Paint Works is an automotive restoration shop in Santee, here in San Diego County. We work on older vehicles from the body and paint to the chassis, interior and performance parts, and we also fix cars after an accident.
We like having you around while we work. Come by the shop, look over your car, ask questions and help make the decisions that make it yours. If you can't visit often, we post progress photos online and can handle billing by phone and email.
Customers have given us a 4.8 rating from 21 Google reviews. One reviewer said the owner Bob "will explain every step," and another said Maggie in the office is easy to talk to.

## Services
- Automotive restoration: Restoration work on classics, hot rods, trucks and other older vehicles, including body work, refinishing, interior and performance work.
- Body work on older vehicles: Body work done the careful way older cars need. One reviewer noted how much work it takes to do it right.
- Accident repairs: One reviewer brought in a car that had been in an accident and was happy with the repairs.

## FAQ
Q: Can I bring my car in on a trailer?
A: Yes. We have off street parking with full trailer access.

Q: I live outside San Diego County. Can you still work on my car?
A: Yes. Send us photos and your contact info and we'll call to talk about the project. Right now we offer free pick up and delivery in the Los Angeles area and Orange County with a fully insured carrier, and we can handle billing by phone and email.

Q: How long have you been around?
A: We've served San Diego County and Southern California since 2004.

## What customers say
- "Bob and his staff are second to none when you are thinking of doing all the right things to your older vehicle. The workers there are so talented and conscientious, they only have the 'right way' in mind when working on your pride and joy. The staff are well connected with the community and have hosted fun car events in the past. It is alot of work to do body work correctly on older vehicles; those who choose to have it done themselves instead of DIY will have to pay for the best. SoCal is the BEST!" (Jon Wirkis, 5/5)
- "Bob and Maggie were incredibly easy to work! The communication was great from start to finish and our bike turned out amazing. I would highly recommend SoCal Paint Works if you need a bike refurbished and painted." (Courtney Maddox, 5/5)
- "The owner Bob is great and will explain every step. And will work with you to solve any issues. My car was involved in a accident,  and so. Cal did a GREAT job with the repairs!" (George Arce, 5/5)
- "Bob and his crew are still working on my 1963 Ranchero. So far things have gone well with replacing the entire front end with a TCI coil over with a heavy duty cross member and 13/8" sway bar, smoothing out the fender wells, installing TCI rack and pinion steering with a new Ididit steering column, and now waiting for the torque arm rear suspension with a 9" Ford. The 347 from Engine Factory should be here this week along with the Level 5 4-speed AOD transmission. Bob has been extremely tolerant of my stopping by once a week or so, and we have stood and talked about our 'fast cars' for hours. Maggie in the office is easy to talk to, and is always helpful when it comes to getting info about the build, or getting info to Bob. Everything should be done and ready to go in about 2-3  months. Can't wait! Gotta be fun when it's done!" (Earl Boyll, 4/5)
